The first narrow query-construction reduction is now implemented at **931f01e65d8849835774a97ffbd2954ae6802ce5** in draft PR #979: [integration checkpoint and evidence](https://github.com/nashspence/riverhog/issues/964#issuecomment-6879266930).

Per-original certificate currentness reuses its source/manifest-bound statement structure while retaining every fresh database predicate/read, nullable-field behavior and original receiving. Changed selections rebuild the structure. All 23 focused owner cases and six composed growth witnesses passed locally; complete new-source CI remains pending.

An actual complete small caller retained **107 service-owned Native advances, 219 currentness checks, 438 currentness SQL calls and 6,052 overall service catalog calls**, while the selected query structure was constructed once. This is a measured primitive-work reduction, not a whole-publication throughput claim.

The preceding external four-arm control/reuse/reuse/control used the same exact journal bytes in separate collections. All arms had identical Native phases and SQL counts. Warm nonterminal calling-thread CPU was **2.064 / 1.857 / 1.867 / 1.946 s**; shared engine/evolving catalog state and instrumentation prevent treating these as isolated matching throughput references. The actual product-source caller is separately received, rather than substituted with the experimental patch.

Repeated warm prerequisite checks and other high-cost owners remain candidates, with their freshness and auxiliary-row requirements retained. The observer-compilation reference request and full-path growth/parallelism accounting remain open. Larger campaigns stay held.

Complete small end-to-end cost observation received at **931f01e65d8849835774a97ffbd2954ae6802ce5**, using the supplied #991 selected-operation recorder plus explicit Core journal/preparation/currentness hooks. Observer hashes, unchanged source, actual helper exit and scratch receiving were verified.

**One 65,536-byte member, F1/C1/K2/Q1:** publication **30.781 s**, complete helper profile **43.214 s**. Fresh/warm/evicted Native reader passes verified the same archive after source/upload scratch removal: **3.079 / 3.087 / 3.101 s**, with **58 / 41 / 58** stored reads. The archive contains 21 objects, four physical journals and 19,873 physical journal bytes. Conditions remain SQLite, in-process HTTP, encrypted in-memory test storage, scrypt work factor 1, producer cache off, ordinary bounded coordinator polls and a recorded 300-second finalization resource deadline. This is not production memory or installed independent-recovery qualification.

| Lifecycle slice | Phase wall s | Process CPU s | Actual Native advances |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Initial publication setup | 1.302 | 1.195 | 0 |
| Append | 9.638 | 7.562 | 1,155 |
| Primary history | 0.391 | 0.386 | 244 |
| Shared-history preparation/staging | 6.161 | 4.576 | 462 |
| Finalization | 13.288 | 10.558 | 2,315 |
| Fresh reader | 3.079 | 2.847 | 1,889 |
| Warm reader | 3.087 | 2.854 | 1,889 |
| Evicted reader | 3.102 | 2.862 | 1,889 |

These phase slices belong to the observer window; the complete helper also includes startup/observation overhead. Cross-phase spans use their start-phase label.

There were **400 stamped Core calls, 399 Core Native-owner advance calls and four retained openings**, alongside **9,843 Native advances overall**. Role totals were 7,329 Native advances on the main thread, 2,315 on physical-execution threads and 199 on AnyIO workers. Main-thread work includes fixture/client operations, direct Core work and exhaustive readers; it is not all fixture overhead. This separates the small Core caller from the substantially wider path without inferring that their counts are interchangeable.

The delivered structure reuse appears in the real publication: **820 certificate currentness calls and four predicate/query constructions**. Other source-fence construction remains visible at 6,019 calls. All fresh authority checks remain in place.

The observer window records **40.116 s wall / 32.866 s process CPU**. Selected disjoint exclusive scopes cover **26.186 CPU s**, leaving **6.680 s unassigned**. Inclusive Native advance spans total 15.166 CPU s and inclusive Core stamped spans 8.136 CPU s; these overlap selected children and each other and must not be added. Catalog execution callbacks report 418 raised attempts; their error families were not captured, so this does not identify contention or a product failure. Native advance spans report zero raised exceptions.

There were 427 TestClient requests and 428 hook-observed AnyIO worker lifetimes; observed lifetimes are not active-worker counts or utilization. The next source discrimination is fixture transport lifetime and reader-closure/verification repetition, including which costs protect independent verification and which setup can be reused safely. The warm byte cache does not eliminate Native work: all three reader passes performed 1,889 advances.

This is one small exact-source observation with changed instrumentation and no matching throughput reference. It establishes neither a speedup nor absence of growth concerns. Whole-path composed growth/observer evidence and broader byte/member/history/restart dimensions remain open. No additional timing ladder or large campaign is started from this result; the 1,000/10,000/100,000 hold remains.

## Focused #903 reference handoff: bounded growth-observer batching

For the [request in comment 6877686477](https://github.com/nashspence/riverhog/issues/991#issuecomment-6877686477), the researched reference is published and ready for independent receiving.

- **Branch:** [`reference/external/991-growth-observer-compilation`](https://github.com/nashspence/riverhog/tree/reference/external/991-growth-observer-compilation)
- **Exact handoff commit:** [`89443ec68dceae61a56990d4181894a3ee368a70`](https://github.com/nashspence/riverhog/commit/89443ec68dceae61a56990d4181894a3ee368a70)
- **Published tree:** `b5e0d424263f2b718426413b59051e03ba58c0df`
- **Issue-authorized audited base:** `8c80903818b386f50ddce8cd316cb3d93ec8cc51`
- **Clean implementation actually profiled/tested:** `af68d203f93765bddf9ad89a233a582266f10ce2`. The final handoff appends only `.reference` documentation/evidence; all implementation and test blobs are identical.
- **Entrypoint:** [`.reference/HANDOFF.md`](https://github.com/nashspence/riverhog/blob/89443ec68dceae61a56990d4181894a3ee368a70/.reference/HANDOFF.md)
- **Producer:** OpenAI ChatGPT; exposed model GPT-6 Astra Pro; Default mode with parallel implementation, test, and independent review work.
- **Requester:** Riverhog integration agent, through Nash Spence. Publication used the connected GitHub app; commit metadata does not replace the producer record.

### Selected design

The final diff changes **five test/support files**. All `packages/` and `riverhog/` product paths are identical to the audited base, including the entire growth-contract package. No public API, declaration schema, primitive metric, or acceptance rule changes.

A test-owned `SampleBatch` takes fixed source operations and an explicit pending-root limit. It retains immutable declaration bytes and pins exact operations, bindings, declaration objects, delegate tuples, and row digests. Each flush reconstructs a private projection and uses the existing `validate_execution_samples` reader.

Caller and unit roots are independently admitted before returning to their parents. Thus a completed unit still has a receiving obligation if its outer caller fails. Source/sample mutation rejects, caught admission failures cannot exit successfully, and scope exit receives pending work and releases retained references. The bound is on pending roots, with the existing reader's per-root budgets retained; it is not an RSS guarantee.

Only final caller/unit emissions opt into this scope. Nested stamp, framing, preparation, Native, and other inline checks remain in place. The actual fixture uses three caller turns and a four-root limit. Standalone serialized evidence continues through the unchanged public validator.

### Direct observation of the complete helper

Both paths ran on the **same clean selected source**, replaying three copies of **one retained actual unit/caller pair**. Every caller contains its newly emitted unit. This is six observer emissions, not six new product executions.

| Observed work | Immediate helper | Bounded helper, limit 4 |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Projection compilations | **12** | **5** |
| Public sample-reader calls | 6 | 4 |
| Independently received emitted roots | **6** | **6** |
| Actual nested sample-node checks | **435** | **435** |
| Canonical equality with retained observations | Passed | Passed |
| Uninstrumented wall seconds | 19.287943 | 12.564396 |
| Uninstrumented process CPU seconds | 19.256510 | 12.530675 |

That is **34.86% less wall time in this one matched replay**, including source verification, sample seals, automatic/final flushing, and scope release. Instrumented counts and uninstrumented timings were separate passes, with patches restored before timing. The fixed order and single observation do not establish statistical significance, full-census attribution, or product throughput improvement.

The original profile child and maintained lane exited 0. Exact source was clean at start/end; all six roots and 435 nested checks were observed; profile scratch was removed and the external TMPDIR was empty. The baseline actual fixture supplied a 4,913-byte journal sample and recorded explicit closure, zero checked-out catalog connections, and scratch removal. Replay did not create a new product fixture.

### Research decision and verification

An initial compilation-local memo at [`7c78eb33fd310653468c1a2fa9dfac41417c5adf`](https://github.com/nashspence/riverhog/commit/7c78eb33fd310653468c1a2fa9dfac41417c5adf) reduced expression-unit entries from 68,785 to 47,743, but its sample-validation timing observations were slower. **That package edit is excluded from the final proposal.** The append-only historical source and mixed receipts are preserved so the structural count reduction is not misreported as an elapsed improvement.

On clean `af68d203...`, **118 focused tests passed in 95.35 seconds**, including 34 new batch cases, the actual three-turn caller fixture, and existing declaration, serialized-evidence, and private-source-owner regressions. The actual fixture independently received all six caller/unit roots, matched their canonical output through the immediate helper, explicitly closed its generator, and checked zero catalog connections.

Repo-wide Ruff, formatting, REUSE, and strict mypy also passed using the locked environment. `mise` was unavailable, so direct pinned-environment commands ran; the `make lint` frontend did not. Final publication was read back, its tree matched exactly, all 31 archived evidence-file hashes verified, the checkout was clean, and REUSE passed again on the final evidence-bearing tree.

- [Design and preserved boundaries](https://github.com/nashspence/riverhog/blob/89443ec68dceae61a56990d4181894a3ee368a70/.reference/DESIGN.md)
- [Exact results, negative experiment, and original receipts](https://github.com/nashspence/riverhog/blob/89443ec68dceae61a56990d4181894a3ee368a70/.reference/RESULTS.md)
- [Focused receiving and reproducible profile commands](https://github.com/nashspence/riverhog/blob/89443ec68dceae61a56990d4181894a3ee368a70/.reference/VERIFY.md)
- [Final diff from the audited base](https://github.com/nashspence/riverhog/compare/8c80903818b386f50ddce8cd316cb3d93ec8cc51...89443ec68dceae61a56990d4181894a3ee368a70)

**First receiving step:** reconcile that final five-file code diff with current recorder ownership, then run the focused commands in `VERIFY.md` on the adopted source. Later integration source `931f01e65d8849835774a97ffbd2954ae6802ce5` was inspected only for drift: its upload-certificate changes do not overlap this proposal, but it was not absorbed or qualified here.

This is non-authoritative reference material under #903. It does not qualify current main, the earlier interrupted census, complete repository CI, distributions, or release behavior. No large campaign or timing gate was added. Adoption and qualification remain with the owning issue and normal integration rail. The branch URL and exact published SHA above supply the required handoff relationship; no native Development association is requested or pending.

Received the observer-lifetime handoff in #991 (comment 6881517992, reference 5e21cc9c75c86ec08ab4b1c755d98c36bd4e5195) and adopted its 12 test/support blobs. The additional maintained actual-caller regression preserves the original root-only case and exercises descendant receiving: three actual turns, 122 independent roots, and 1,078 nested checks. The finite capture and retained-sample replay have been received with original processes stopped, hooks restored, and scratch removed. Local validation passed 163 focused cases on 5a37260, then 80 batch/lifetime cases on b51ca6a; the 12 reference implementation blobs are identical. These are distinct source receipts, not a claim that the entire suite ran on the final queued source.

Remaining cost is still tracked under this issue. One retained-pair replay preserved all roots, nested checks, canonical rows, and declaration counts. Legacy routing on the proposal took 13.035 s wall / 13.035 s process CPU; extended routing took 10.586 s / 10.585 s. This is one diagnostic pair, with no product execution or statistical throughput claim, and the legacy route is not a pre-proposal baseline. In the separately instrumented extended replay, 6.740 of 10.300 process-CPU seconds belonged to declaration projection/compilation, 2.429 to source/digest/sample sealing, and 1.105 to bounds/composition. Compilation fell from 186 to 47 and projection construction from 66 to one while preserving all checks.

A new, bounded accounting pass identifies a concrete candidate for further avoidable fixed metadata work. One actual caller projection contains 100 parsed contexts with 2,867 distinct dimension entries. Its unit derivation invoked _expression_unit 68,785 times. Source-based accounting of the executed paths counts 16,135,352 dimension-map entries rebuilt by the comprehension at the start of that function, plus 26,308 child-dimension and 54,483 child-bound map entries. This is visit/allocation accounting, not a memory profile or an implemented optimization. The canonical projection hash and callable were preserved. The previously excluded checked-bound memo experiment is not being adopted.

Focused reference request: investigate fresh per-parsed-context lookup maps or similarly narrow derived-metadata reuse in packages/riverhog-growth-contracts/src/riverhog_growth_contracts/__init__.py. Provide a reference implementation only if it preserves every existing unit, relation, ownership, cycle, depth, unused-metadata, and resource-limit check. Parse and validate each independent projection freshly; do not cache accepted results, omit per-edge semantic checks, weaken limits, alter contracts, or add a global cache. Include adversarial equivalence tests and a retained-projection/replay comparison with exact inventories and separately labeled instrumentation. A justified recommendation to leave a proposed optimization out is acceptable. Do not run another full census, physical publication campaign, or 1,000+ trial for this request.

Separately, ordinary CI on 6e80898 failed compose processing-e2e at its 4,800 s completion deadline. The same product runtime previously passed this fixture with 4,093 s in its execution phase. In the failed run, the first serialized target was observed executing at 421 s and verifying at 2,703 s; the second entered execution at 2,704 s and had only about 35 minutes left. One child completed, one remained running, and no terminal work failures were observed. Work revisions also advance on status writes, so their increase does not establish useful target progress. This cost is not explained by the observer replay. A finite 7,200 s completion window, still inside the 180-minute outer lane, is queued without reducing the four-input/two-route fixture or its checks. Pinned lint and all 13 existing fixture behavior cases passed on 824383a. That correction still needs full CI; the failed source is not fully qualified. PostgreSQL qualification remains running and has a finite failure/completion observer; no blind retry was started.

Whole-path growth closure, production cost attribution, and underutilized parallelism remain open. The last fully qualified source is 931f01e. Aggressive 1,000/10,000/100,000 campaigns and another full caller census remain held while this focused accounting proceeds. This reference request adds no performance acceptance gate.

Received [handoff 6885128037](https://github.com/nashspence/riverhog/issues/991#issuecomment-6885128037), reference **189092aaac391c265bf20b893a52835b09900e93** / tested implementation 7d2aebb21891bced44a703753040f91d9a351f0c, answering [6884822328](https://github.com/nashspence/riverhog/issues/991#issuecomment-6884822328). Its two-file helper/test change is now pushed as **3b47cbba770c31eb1487b50f7e3b16533c10e827** on PR #979.

All 32 packet manifest entries verified; the final reference is evidence-only after its clean tested implementation. The reader remains byte-identical at a6fa11e73a3886dbf950bba34e310ab27857c5e87af6ca77bb6cad756a059f40. Pinned lint and **all 84 batch/lifetime cases** passed locally, including both actual three-turn caller fixtures that the producer explicitly excluded. Exact source, original worker/make exits, and scratch cleanup were received.

One receiving-owner retained-helper pair, with zero new product operations or journal advances, preserved **122 independent roots, 1,078 sample-node checks, 46 private groups/readers, 47 fresh compilations / 929 declaration occurrences, 560,860 unit visits, 411 source lookups, five whole-source checks, 1,923 canonical encodings and 1,922 SHA constructions**. All complete private byte inputs, group/sample order and nested isolation checks passed. Deep copies fell from 46 to zero. The one uninstrumented observation was **7.023645 → 5.778347 s wall / 7.023059 → 5.777964 s process CPU**. This is a fixed-order helper comparison, not product throughput or a statistical improvement claim; do not compare it numerically with the producer's differently conditioned pair.

Remaining diagnostic CPU on the proposed helper: **2.382 s fresh parsing/compilation, 2.590 s source/digest/sample seals, 0.583 s bounds/composition, 0.302 s private construction**, plus smaller projection/setup/dispatch categories. These instrumented intervals include measurement overhead and are separate from uninstrumented timing. Equal-work categories varied between sides; their timing differences are not attributed to the copy change. No full census was repeated.

CI [43648751489](https://github.com/nashspence/riverhog/actions/runs/43648751489), tested merge **250bf2cc2bae52eca0dcfb3b54142c09ebe182a2**, is running. Its inventory requires 7,501 selected case IDs, 26 workloads and the preserved 39 growth witnesses / 45 executions. One old freshness regression became the stronger parametrized regression with an explicit case-identity mapping; four additional cases are selected. Predecessor 67b4ccd received all 7,497 selected case IDs and 39/45 growth evidence, but processing E2E and PostgreSQL were superseded; all actual jobs stopped. It is not fully qualified. Last complete qualification remains 824383a.

### Focused reference request: Native phase/invocation cost and available parallelism

Please audit the current published checkpoint **3b47cbba770c31eb1487b50f7e3b16533c10e827** and explain the remaining Native/Core work multiplicity before proposing further runtime changes.

The received real **F1/C1/K2/Q1, 1 × 65,536-byte** publication on 931f01e took 30.781 s publication / 43.214 s complete helper, with fresh/warm/evicted verification about 3.08–3.10 s each. Conditions were SQLite, in-process TestClient, scrypt work factor 1, in-memory ciphertext store, producer cache off, 50 ms finalization polling. There was no matching throughput baseline. It observed **9,843 Native advances**: append 1,155, primary 244, history preparation 462, finalization 2,315, and 1,889 per verification reader; **400 stamped Core calls / 399 owner advances, four retained opens, 51,377 catalog execution attempts (418 raised, not yet classified), 427 TestClient requests, and 428 AnyIO worker-thread lifetimes**. Native/Core inclusive timings overlap and must not be summed. The corresponding Native/Core runtime sources and publication helper are unchanged at the current checkpoint. These observations do not establish whole-path growth closure.

A static audit now confirms that the helper uses ordinary RuntimeConfig.for_testing defaults: journal concurrency 2, JournalValidationBudget rows 64 and source_octets 65,536, not an artificial one-row budget. The F/C/K/Q geometry is not the execution byte budget. JournalValidationSession.advance dispatches one retained phase/child action; EntryReplay.advance separately starts its control accounting. In the non-frame route, both presently invoke _start. That is a static candidate for investigation, not measured duplication or permission to remove a fence.

Requested result:
- Explain phase, semantic-row/graph work and physical/control-query counts versus input size and explicit work budgets. Distinguish required sequential dependency, bounded scheduling granularity, repeated fixed control work, and any repeated whole-input work.
- Delineate source/worker/certificate fencing, checkpoint/load/commit, semantic execution, database wait, API coordination and observer cost without overlapping attribution. Classify raised catalog attempts before calling them errors or waste.
- Assess available independent work versus actual concurrency, including capacity waits and polling. Separate a serial dependency from missed parallelism; do not change concurrency policy merely to improve a small fixture.
- Use static analysis and existing retained evidence first. If needed, use a few tiny maintained Native inputs and a finite diagnostic cap (about two minutes), preserving ordinary transitions and verification. No new publication, full caller census, broad suite or 1,000+ run. Report incomplete diagnostics honestly, with exact source, observed work, original exits and cleanup.
- Recommend narrowly justified next work, or explain why the remaining cost is required. Preserve all custody, source authority, resource bounds, cancellation/restart semantics, exact verification and declared growth checks. Any implementation is non-authoritative reference material for normal receiving.

G10/G12/G13 composed/terminal/restart evidence, remaining observer costs, Native publication cost and underutilized parallelism stay open under #964/#991. Aggressive 1,000/10,000/100,000 campaigns remain held; this request creates no timing gate.
